description: Server drains with last_stream_id:3, then (mis)opens stream 5, which is above the announced boundary. OVERVIEW.md section 2.7 Drain: 'A client receiving OPEN with id > last_stream_id after drain MUST treat it as connection PROTOCOL_ERROR (4001) -- strict, not a stream-scoped REFUSED_STREAM, because it means the server has violated the boundary it already promised.' See also section 2.9 Drain and the decision log's 2026-08-27 entry -- only the server opens streams, so only the client is ever in a position to detect this.
